repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface.
repos.summary_zh: ComfyUI 是一款功能强大的模块化扩散模型 GUI 工具，采用节点/流程图界面设计，支持复杂 Stable Diffusion 工作流的图形化编排。它提供无代码可视化操作，兼容 SD1.x/SD2.x/SDXL/SD3/Flux 等多种模型，支持 NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Apple Silicon 等全平台 GPU，适用于图像生成、视频处理、AI 艺术创作等场景。
repos.summary_en: ComfyUI is a powerful modular GUI for diffusion models featuring a node-based graph interface for building complex Stable Diffusion pipelines without coding. It supports multiple models including SD1.x, SDXL, SD3, Flux, and PixArt, runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS with full GPU support across NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple Silicon platforms.

repos.description: Make images smaller using best-in-class codecs, right in the browser.
repos.summary_zh: Squoosh 是一款浏览器内图像压缩工具，利用顶级编解码器显著减小图像体积，所有处理均在本地完成，保护用户隐私。支持多种格式压缩，提供实时预览与尺寸对比，适用于网页优化与资源管理。
repos.summary_en: Squoosh is a browser-based image compression tool that reduces image sizes using best-in-class codecs entirely in the browser. It supports multiple formats, offers real-time preview and size comparison, and ensures privacy by processing images locally without server transmission.

repos.description: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
repos.summary_zh: Maple Mono 是一款专为提升编码体验而设计的开源等宽字体，具有圆角设计、连字功能及 Nerd-Font 图标支持，适用于 IDE 和终端环境。其特色包括可变字重、智能连字、中英文 2:1 完美对齐，以及细粒度自定义选项，支持简繁中文和日文，适合多语言开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding flow, featuring rounded corners, ligatures, and Nerd-Font icons for IDEs and terminals. It offers variable font weights, smart ligatures, perfect 2:1 Chinese-English alignment, and extensive customization, supporting Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese for multilingual development environments.

repos.description: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》（李宏毅老师推荐👍，苹果书🍎），PDF下载地址：https://github.com/datawhalechina/leedl-tutorial/releases
repos.summary_zh: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》是台湾大学李宏毅教授经典课程的中文教程，涵盖深度学习核心理论与前沿技术。教程以幽默易懂的方式讲解复杂概念，结合动画案例与详细公式推导，降低学习门槛。内容源自2021年春课程并扩展2017年春课程及外部知识，适合深度学习初学者系统入门。
repos.summary_en: LeeDL-Tutorial is a comprehensive Chinese guide to deep learning based on Professor Hung-yi Lee's renowned courses. It simplifies complex concepts through engaging examples and detailed derivations, covering core theories and techniques. Expanded from the 2021 Spring course with additional content from 2017 and external resources, it serves as an ideal entry point for beginners in deep learning.

repos.description: A simple app to use Xposed without root, unlock the bootloader or modify system image, etc.
repos.summary_zh: VirtualXposed 是一款基于 VirtualApp 和 epic 技术的 Android 应用，无需 root、解锁 bootloader 或修改系统镜像即可运行 Xposed 模块。支持 Android 5.0~10.0，适用于绝大多数非系统级修改的模块，如广告拦截、功能增强等。用户可在虚拟环境中独立安装应用与模块，并通过内置重启功能快速生效，极大提升了 Android 系统的灵活性与可玩性。
repos.summary_en: VirtualXposed is an Android app built on VirtualApp and epic that enables Xposed module usage without root, bootloader unlock, or system image modification. It supports Android 5.0–10.0 and works with most non-system modules like ad blockers and app enhancements. Users can install apps and modules in a virtual environment and reboot within the app for instant activation, offering a safe and flexible way to customize Android without system-level changes.

repos.description: 一站式原生AI PPT生成应用，几分钟内生成一套幻灯片; 支持上传任意模板图片，上传任意素材&智能解析，一句话/大纲/页面描述自动生成PPT，口头修改指定区域、一键导出可编辑ppt、视频等 - An AI-native slides generator based on nano banana/gpt-image🏞️
repos.summary_zh: 基于nano banana pro🍌原生AI驱动的PPT生成工具，支持一句话/大纲/页面描述快速创作，具备智能素材解析、自然语言局部修改和一键导出可编辑PPTX功能，实现真正的'Vibe PPT'体验。
repos.summary_en: An AI-native slides generator powered by nano banana pro🍌, enabling rapid PPT creation from ideas, outlines, or descriptions with intelligent material parsing, natural language-based local edits, and one-click export to editable PPTX format.

repos.description: 微信《跳一跳》Python 辅助
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个基于 Python 的微信小游戏《跳一跳》自动化辅助工具，通过图像识别技术自动识别棋子位置与目标方块，结合 ADB 控制手机屏幕实现精准跳跃。支持手动校准与自动识别两种模式，利用像素距离计算按压时长，帮助用户高效刷分登顶排行榜。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Python-based automation tool for WeChat's mini-game 'Jump Jump'. It uses image recognition to detect the player's position and target blocks, calculates the required press duration based on pixel distance, and controls the screen via ADB to achieve precise jumps, enabling automatic high-score gameplay.

repos.description: 这个项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具。它能够中转对 Docker 官方镜像仓库的请求，解决一些访问限制和加速访问的问题。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具，通过中转请求解决官方仓库访问限制与加速问题。支持 Docker、Containerd、Podman 等多种容器运行时配置镜像加速，提供一键部署方案，适用于跨境网络环境下的镜像拉取优化。
repos.summary_en: A Docker image proxy tool built on Cloudflare Workers that relays requests to official repositories to bypass access restrictions and accelerate downloads. Supports configuration for Docker, Containerd, and Podman runtimes with one-click deployment options, ideal for optimizing image pulls in cross-border networks.

repos.description: 截屏 离线OCR 搜索翻译 以图搜图 贴图 录屏 万向滚动截屏 屏幕翻译   Screenshot  Offline OCR   Search   Translate   Search for picture   Paste the picture on the screen   Screen recorder   Omnidirectional scrolling screenshot   Screen translator  支持Windows Linux macOS
repos.summary_zh: eSearch 是一款跨平台屏幕搜索工具，集成截屏、离线OCR、翻译、以图搜图、贴图、录屏和万向滚动截屏功能。基于 Electron 开发，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，提供高度自定义的 OCR 识别、多引擎翻译及 AI 图像交互能力，适用于高效信息提取与屏幕内容管理。
repos.summary_en: eSearch is a cross-platform screen search tool featuring screenshot, offline OCR, translation, reverse image search, screen overlay, screencasting, and omnidirectional scrolling capture. Built with Electron for Windows, Linux, and macOS, it offers customizable OCR, multi-engine translation, and AI-powered image interaction for efficient content extraction and management.

repos.description: 🏖️ A serverless, open-source file hosting solution built on Cloudflare. Supports image hosting, secure file storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: CloudFlare-ImgBed 是一个基于 Cloudflare 的无服务器开源文件托管解决方案，支持 Docker 和 Serverless 部署。它提供图片托管、安全文件存储和个人云盘功能，兼容 Telegram、Discord、R2、S3、Huggingface、WebDAV 等多种存储后端，并内置 RESTful API 与 WebDAV 支持，适用于轻量级私有云搭建。
repos.summary_en: CloudFlare-ImgBed is a serverless, open-source file hosting solution built on Cloudflare. It supports image hosting, secure file storage, and personal cloud drive capabilities via Docker or serverless deployment. Compatible with multiple storage backends like R2, S3, WebDAV, and more, it offers RESTful APIs and WebDAV support for flexible integration.

repos.description: ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现，支持GPT-Image-2模型、文本模型，兼容OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生图/编辑图，号池管理，支持可编辑PPT/PSD文件逆向，支持导入CPA、sub2api号池 、支持接入Cherry  Studio、New Api 等软件
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT2API 是对 ChatGPT 官网能力逆向封装的 OpenAI 兼容 API 代理，支持文生图、图片编辑与多图组图功能，集成号池管理、多种账号导入方式及 Docker 自托管部署，提供完整的在线画图工作台与缓存机制。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is an OpenAI-compatible API proxy that reverse-engineers ChatGPT's image generation and editing capabilities, featuring account pool management, multi-import methods, Docker deployment, and a built-in online drawing workspace with caching support.

repos.description: Red Ink - A one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator based on the 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, "One Sentence, One Image: Generate Xiaohongshu Text and Images."
repos.summary_zh: 红墨是基于🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌的一站式小红书图文生成器，支持一句话生成完整图文内容，包含智能大纲、封面页和内容页批量生成。采用Python Flask后端与Vue 3前端，支持Docker一键部署，集成Gemini 3文案与图片生成能力，提供可视化配置界面。
repos.summary_en: RedInk is a one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator powered by 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, enabling instant creation of complete posts from a single sentence. It features AI-driven outline generation, cover page design, and batch content creation. Built with Python Flask backend and Vue 3 frontend, it supports Docker deployment and integrates Gemini 3 for text and image generation with a user-friendly web interface.

repos.description: Python QR Code image generator
repos.summary_zh: 纯 Python 编写的 QR 码生成库，支持生成 PNG、SVG 等格式图像，提供命令行工具和 Python API。可自定义尺寸、颜色、纠错等级等参数，适用于快速生成二维码并集成到自动化流程中。
repos.summary_en: A pure Python library for generating QR codes, supporting PNG, SVG, and console output. Offers command-line interface and Python API with customizable parameters like size, colors, and error correction levels, ideal for automation and integration.

repos.description: 🦋 An Infographic Generation and Rendering Framework, bring words to life with AI!
repos.summary_zh: AntV Infographic 是蚂蚁集团 AntV 团队推出的下一代声明式信息图可视化引擎，提供约200个内置模板和组件，支持AI友好语法配置，可快速生成高质量SVG信息图，具备主题系统、内置编辑器和数据叙事能力，适用于数据可视化与内容创作场景。
repos.summary_en: AntV Infographic is AntV's next-generation declarative infographic visualization engine, offering ~200 built-in templates and components. It supports AI-friendly syntax for rapid generation of high-quality SVG infographics, featuring a theme system, built-in editor, and data storytelling capabilities for visualization and content creation.

repos.description: LiYing is an automated photo processing program designed for automating the post-processing workflow of ID photos in general photo studios. | LiYing 是一套适用于自动化 完成一般照相馆后期证件照处理流程的照片自动处理的程序。
repos.summary_zh: LiYing 是一款专为照相馆设计的证件照自动化处理程序，支持人体与面部智能识别、角度自动校正、背景色更换、多尺寸裁切及排版。完全离线运行，所有图像处理均在本地完成，适用于单人标准肖像照的批量高效处理。
repos.summary_en: LiYing is an automated photo processing program tailored for photo studios, enabling intelligent human and face detection, automatic angle correction, background replacement, multi-size cropping, and layout. It runs entirely offline with all image processing performed locally, ideal for batch processing standard single-person ID photos.

repos.description: Pic Smaller – Compress JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, SVG and GIF images intelligently
repos.summary_zh: Pic Smaller 是一款智能在线图像压缩工具，支持 JPEG、PNG、WEBP、AVIF、SVG 和 GIF 格式。采用纯前端技术实现，无需服务器处理，确保数据安全。提供格式转换、色彩优化、压缩对比等高级功能，界面简洁，兼容桌面与移动端，适合快速压缩与编辑图像。
repos.summary_en: Pic Smaller is an intelligent online image compression tool supporting JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, SVG, and GIF formats. Built with pure frontend technologies like WebAssembly and Web Worker, it ensures complete privacy by processing images locally. Offers advanced features such as format conversion, color optimization, and side-by-side compression comparison, with a responsive UI for desktop and mobile.

repos.description: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.
repos.summary_zh: Afilmory 是一款专为摄影师打造的高性能现代照片画廊平台，支持 S3/GitHub 同步、EXIF 元数据展示、地理地图可视化和 WebGL 渲染，提供响应式瀑布流布局和国际化支持，适用于自建或 SaaS 部署。
repos.summary_en: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

repos.description: 体验极佳的Android图片手势控件。An Android image gesture control with excellent user experience.
repos.summary_zh: PinchImageView 是一款高性能 Android 图片手势控件，提供流畅的单指滑动、双指缩放、惯性滚动等交互体验。支持大图分段加载、分辨率切换、边界反弹及自定义扩展，集成简单且无外部依赖，适用于高清图片浏览场景。
repos.summary_en: PinchImageView is a high-performance Android image gesture control with smooth single-finger swipe, two-finger pinch-zoom, and inertia scrolling. It supports large image segment loading, resolution switching, boundary rebound, and extensible APIs, making it ideal for high-definition image viewing with minimal integration effort.

repos.description: File and Image Management Application for django
repos.summary_zh: django-filer 是专为 Django 设计的文件与图片管理应用，提供直观的文件库管理、图片裁剪、批量操作等功能，深度集成 django CMS，支持拖拽上传、权限控制和多格式预览，显著提升内容管理系统的媒体资源管理效率。
repos.summary_en: Django Filer is a file and image management application for Django that simplifies handling of media assets. It offers intuitive file browsing, image manipulation, batch operations, and seamless integration with django CMS, enhancing content management workflows with drag-and-drop uploads, permission controls, and multi-format support.

repos.description: Responsive Image Maps jQuery Plugin
repos.summary_zh: jQuery RWD Image Maps 是一个响应式图像地图插件，通过动态重计算坐标，使 HTML 图像映射在窗口缩放或图像尺寸变化时保持精准定位，适用于响应式网页设计中的交互式图像区域。
repos.summary_en: jQuery RWD Image Maps is a responsive image maps plugin that recalculates area coordinates dynamically to maintain accurate clickable regions when images resize, ideal for interactive responsive web designs using HTML image maps.

repos.description: Snip Anything Solve Everything​
repos.summary_zh: Snippai 是一款基于先进 AI 算法的智能截图工具，支持公式识别（转 LaTeX）、文本提取、表格转 Markdown、图像分析、代码理解、颜色检测和多语言翻译等功能，显著提升截图处理效率与智能化水平。
repos.summary_en: Snippai is an AI-powered intelligent snipping tool that leverages advanced algorithms to recognize formulas (LaTeX conversion), extract text, convert tables to Markdown, analyze images, understand code, detect colors, and translate text in any language—enhancing productivity through smart screenshot processing.

repos.description: OpenAI-compatible API for Gemini Business with multi-account load balancing and multimodal capabilities (image/video generation, file parsing) | 将 Gemini Business 转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡及多模态能力（图像生成、视频生成、解析文件）
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Business2API 将 Gemini Business 转换为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账户负载均衡、自动化注册登录、多模态文件解析（100+格式）、图像/视频生成及流式输出。提供 Docker 部署、管理面板和 PostgreSQL/SQLite 存储，适用于个人技术研究与非商业场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Business2API converts Gemini Business into an OpenAI-compatible API with multi-account load balancing, automated account management, multimodal file parsing (100+ formats), image/video generation, and streaming responses. Features Docker deployment, admin panel, and PostgreSQL/SQLite persistence for non-commercial research use.

repos.description: 自部署的摄影作品网站，支持多种功能特性。PicImpact，分享你和世界！
repos.summary_zh: PicImpact 是一个基于 Next.js + Hono.js 的自部署摄影作品展示网站，支持瀑布流相册、WebGL 高性能图片查看器（含实况照片与分块加载）、地图标记、EXIF 信息展示、双因素认证、Passkey 无密码登录及多存储后端兼容。具备响应式设计、暗黑模式、RSS 订阅与自动化上传功能，适合个人或团队搭建专业图库平台。
repos.summary_en: PicImpact is a self-deployable photography portfolio built with Next.js and Hono.js, featuring a masonry gallery, WebGL-powered image viewer (with Live Photos support), EXIF-based geotagging, TOTP/Passkey authentication, multi-storage backend compatibility, RSS feeds, and responsive design. Ideal for creators to showcase high-resolution images with performance optimization.

repos.description: [NeurIPS 2024] DreamClear: High-Capacity Real-World Image Restoration with Privacy-Safe Dataset Curation
repos.summary_zh: DreamClear 是 NeurIPS 2024 论文提出的高容量真实世界图像修复系统，通过隐私安全的语料库构建技术，实现高质量图像恢复。其核心创新在于结合 PixArt-α 生成模型与多模态对齐能力，支持文本引导修复，并在 RealLQ250 基准测试中表现优异，适用于摄影、遥感等真实场景。
repos.summary_en: DreamClear, presented at NeurIPS 2024, is a high-capacity real-world image restoration framework featuring privacy-safe dataset curation. It leverages the PixArt-α generative model with multimodal alignment for text-guided restoration, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the RealLQ250 benchmark across diverse real-world scenarios including photography and remote sensing.

repos.description: 🚀 即梦3.0逆向API【特长：图像生成顶流】，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 即梦3.0逆向API服务，提供零配置部署的图像生成能力，支持多路token并发，兼容OpenAI接口标准，每日免费66次生成额度，适用于个人测试与学习用途。
repos.summary_en: Jimeng AI Free API service enables zero-configuration deployment of image generation via reverse-engineered API, supporting multiple tokens and OpenAI-compatible interface, offering 66 daily free generations for testing purposes.

repos.description: [ICLR 2026] A Training-free Iterative Framework for Long Story Visualization
repos.summary_zh: Story-Iter 是一个免训练迭代框架，用于长故事可视化。它通过引入全局参考交叉注意力（GRCA）模块，在扩散模型中实现多轮图像生成与优化，显著提升长序列（最高100帧）的语义一致性和细粒度交互质量，无需额外训练即可达到SOTA性能。
repos.summary_en: Story-Iter is a training-free iterative framework for long story visualization. By introducing the Global Reference Cross-Attention (GRCA) module into diffusion models, it enables multi-round image generation and refinement, significantly improving semantic consistency and fine-grained interactions in long sequences (up to 100 frames), achieving state-of-the-art performance without additional training.

repos.description: A JavaScript library to display Photo Sphere panoramas.
repos.summary_zh: Photo Sphere Viewer 是一个基于 Three.js 的 JavaScript 库，用于在网页上展示 360×180 度全景图。支持 equirectangular 投影格式，兼容 Android 4.2+ 拍摄的照片球，提供丰富的交互控制与自定义选项，适用于虚拟旅游、房地产展示等场景。
repos.summary_en: Photo Sphere Viewer is a JavaScript library built on Three.js for displaying 360×180 degree panoramas on web pages. It supports equirectangular projection, integrates with Android Photo Sphere, and offers extensive customization and interaction features for immersive experiences.

repos.description: Create beautiful SVG guitar chord charts
repos.summary_zh: SVGuitar 是一个基于 JavaScript/TypeScript 的 SVG 吉他和弦图生成库，支持在浏览器中直接渲染美观的和弦图表。它提供高度可定制的配置选项，包括手指位置、横按标记、标题样式等，适用于音乐教育、乐谱制作等场景，并可通过 npm 安装集成到项目中。
repos.summary_en: SVGuitar is a JavaScript/TypeScript library that generates beautiful SVG guitar chord charts directly in the browser. It offers highly customizable configurations for finger positions, barre chords, titles, and more, making it ideal for music education and sheet music creation. It can be installed via npm or used as a UMD script.

repos.description: A diffusion model to colorize black and white images
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用扩散模型对黑白图像进行自动着色，采用LAB颜色空间分离亮度与色彩通道，仅对色彩通道添加噪声并预测去噪结果。模型基于UNet架构，结合灰度图像特征进行条件控制，实现端到端的图像着色。项目展示了从噪声生成彩色图像的过程，适用于历史影像修复、老照片上色等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project implements a diffusion model for automatic colorization of black-and-white images using the LAB color space, where only the color channels are noised and predicted. The UNet-based model conditions on grayscale features and predicts denoised color channels, enabling end-to-end image colorization. It's suitable for restoring historical photos and enhancing old images.

repos.description: A customizable plug-in photo gallery management application for the Django web framework.
repos.summary_zh: Django-photologue 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的强大图片管理与画廊应用，支持上传照片、创建画廊、添加水印等效果，提供灵活的插件化架构，适用于构建定制化图片展示网站。
repos.summary_en: Django-photologue is a powerful image management and gallery application for Django, enabling photo uploads, gallery organization, watermarking, and flexible customization for web-based photo displays.

repos.description: AigoTools can help users quickly create and manage website directory, with built-in site auto-crawling features, and also provides internationalization, SEO, image storage, and other functions. It allows users to quickly deploy their own directory site online.
repos.summary_zh: AigoTools 是一款导航站建站工具，支持快速创建和管理网站目录，内置自动爬虫抓取站点信息（基于 Playwright、Jina、OpenAI），提供用户管理、国际化、SEO 优化及多平台图片存储（MinIO、AWS S3、腾讯云 COS）。用户可一键部署个性化导航网站，适合内容聚合与分类管理场景。
repos.summary_en: AigoTools is a navigation site builder that enables rapid creation and management of website directories with built-in auto-crawling (using Playwright, Jina, OpenAI), user management (Clerk), internationalization, SEO, and multi-cloud image storage (MinIO, AWS S3, Tencent COS). It allows instant deployment of customizable navigation sites for content aggregation and categorization.

repos.description: 一款手势驱动的裁图插件 / A gesture to drive image cropping plug-in
repos.summary_zh: PhotoClip.js 是一款手势驱动的移动端图片裁剪插件，支持双指缩放、旋转等直观操作，兼容主流浏览器。通过集成 iscroll-zoom、hammer.js 和 lrz 压缩库，实现高效图片裁剪与压缩，适用于移动端照片处理场景，提供灵活的配置选项和回调机制。
repos.summary_en: PhotoClip.js is a gesture-driven image cropping plugin for mobile devices, supporting intuitive pinch-to-zoom and rotation. It integrates iscroll-zoom, hammer.js, and lrz compression for efficient image processing. Compatible with modern browsers, it offers flexible configuration and callbacks for mobile photo editing workflows.

repos.description: 吉他和弦推导算法
repos.summary_zh: guitarChord 是一个吉他和弦推导算法项目，支持根据输入和弦名称自动生成标准指法图，并提供 SVG 可视化输出。基于 React 构建，包含完整的前端交互界面和静态部署能力，适用于音乐教学与练习场景。
repos.summary_en: guitarChord is a guitar chord derivation algorithm that generates standard fingerings and SVG visualizations based on input chord names. Built with React, it features an interactive web interface for music education and practice.

repos.description: 面向电商商品图生产场景的图片套图 Skill。仓库提供一套从商品图分析、卖点提炼、Prompt 组织到成图输出的脚本与配置，适合用在淘宝、京东、拼多多、抖音等国内平台，以及独立站、Amazon 等跨境场景。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供电商商品图自动化生产工具，支持从原图分析、卖点提炼到多类型套图生成全流程。覆盖白底主图、卖点图、场景展示等8种标准图型，适配淘宝、京东、Amazon等平台。通过结构化输出为详情页、视频等内容提供统一素材，已验证服饰、电器等多品类场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers an automated e-commerce image suite generator, enabling end-to-end workflows from product image analysis to multi-format output. It supports 8 standard image types (e.g., white-bg hero images, feature highlights, lifestyle scenes) and is compatible with platforms like Taobao, Amazon, and TikTok. Structured outputs streamline content creation for listings, videos, and detail pages across apparel, electronics, and more.

repos.description: 基于Go语言编写的ChatGPT官网接口纯协议的逆向实现GPT-Image-2生图，兼容多OpenAI接口协议，在线批量生成图像
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT2API 是一个基于 Go 的 ChatGPT 官网接口逆向实现，提供 OpenAI 兼容的图片生成、编辑 API 及多模型文本处理能力。支持号池管理、CPA/sub2api 账号导入、Docker 自托管部署，并集成 React 前端创作台与权限管理系统，适用于非商业性技术研究与个人开发场景。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT2API is a Go-based reverse-engineered implementation of ChatGPT's official interface, offering OpenAI-compatible image generation, editing APIs, and multi-model text support. It features account pool management, CPA/sub2api integration, Docker deployment, and a React frontend with creation studio and RBAC permissions—designed for non-commercial R&D use.

repos.description: AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，使用 **FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]** 前沿模型提供强大的图像编辑功能，支持Stripe支付，注册登录，积分系统等，代码100%开源。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 15 构建的现代化 AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，集成前沿 FLUX.1 Kontext Pro 模型，支持智能编辑、背景移除、多格式输出及 Stripe 支付，提供完整的用户认证、积分系统和国际化支持，代码完全开源。
repos.summary_en: A modern AI image editing web app built with Next.js 15, powered by the cutting-edge FLUX.1 Kontext Pro model. Features intelligent editing, background removal, multi-format support, Stripe payments, user authentication, points system, and full internationalization, with 100% open-source code.

repos.description: Open-source Android vault app to hide photos, videos, audio, notes & documents securely with AES encryption
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.summary_zh: 魔法AI绘画是一个基于Next.js构建的跨平台AI绘画应用，支持多种主流AI模型（如Sora、DALL-E、GPT、GEMINI等）及自定义模型扩展。提供文生图、图生图、区域编辑和多图参考功能，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全，支持网页版与桌面应用部署。
repos.summary_en: Magic Image is a cross-platform AI painting application built with Next.js, supporting multiple AI models (Sora, DALL-E, GPT, GEMINI, etc.) and custom model integration. It offers text-to-image, image-to-image, region editing, and multi-reference image support, with all data stored locally for privacy. Available as both a web app and desktop application.

repos.description: 🎸 A portable guitar tabs editor 🎼 based on react.js, inspired by Markdown and LaTex.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 React.js 开发的便携式吉他谱编辑器，灵感来自 Markdown 和 LaTeX。采用 SVG 技术渲染和弦与谱表组件，支持实时预览。已发布两个相关 npm 包（react-guitar-lyrics、react-chord-generator）供开发者参考。具备响应式界面与基础编辑功能，适合音乐创作者快速编写吉他谱。
repos.summary_en: A portable guitar tabs editor built with React.js, inspired by Markdown and LaTeX. Uses SVG to render chords and tab notation with real-time preview. Includes two published npm packages (react-guitar-lyrics, react-chord-generator) for chord development. Designed for music creators to efficiently compose guitar tabs with a responsive interface.

repos.description: A lightweight, no-dependency image slider library
repos.summary_zh: PureSlider 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 图片轮播库，支持淡入淡出切换效果。它无需 jQuery 等外部库，提供简洁的 API 和自定义配置选项，适用于现代网页开发中的图片展示场景。
repos.summary_en: PureSlider is a lightweight, dependency-free image slider library that supports fade transitions. It offers a simple API and customizable options, ideal for modern web projects requiring jQuery-free image carousels.

repos.description: AI图像生成网页交互平台 - 基于Streamlit构建的Web应用，提供简洁的用户界面和实用的图像生成功能
repos.summary_zh: ShowImageWeb是基于Streamlit构建的AI图像生成网页交互平台，提供简洁美观的用户界面和强大的图像生成功能。支持多API服务、CloudScraper反爬虫技术、多尺寸输出、步数调节及本地Key保存，适配移动端并具备固定画廊、实时进度显示和一键下载等实用特性。
repos.summary_en: ShowImageWeb is an AI image generation web platform built with Streamlit, offering a clean UI and robust image generation features. It supports multiple APIs, CloudScraper anti-crawling tech, adjustable steps/sizes, local API key storage, mobile optimization, fixed gallery, real-time progress tracking, and one-click PNG downloads.

repos.description: A free macOS native app to remove image backgrounds locally
repos.summary_zh: Figura 是一款免费的 macOS 原生应用，利用系统 Vision 框架实现本地快速背景去除，支持拖拽、粘贴或点击上传，界面简洁现代，兼容深色/浅色模式，专为 macOS 14+ 设计。
repos.summary_en: Figura is a free native macOS app that leverages the system's Vision framework for fast, local background removal. It supports drag-and-drop, paste (⌘V), or click upload, features a minimalist SwiftUI interface, and works on macOS 14+ with dark/light mode support.

repos.description: 开源AI生图工具，免登录畅玩 FLUX2、SDXL，支持 cloudflare workers 一键部署自托管，并集成各大主流AI提供商，提供一站式的创作体验。
repos.summary_zh: Typix 是一款开源 AI 生图工具，支持免登录使用 FLUX2、SDXL 等主流模型，提供 Cloudflare Workers 一键自托管部署，集成 Google、OpenAI、Fal 等多平台 AI 服务，兼具浏览器本地存储与可选云同步，保障用户数据隐私与创作自由。
repos.summary_en: Typix is an open-source AI image generation tool that enables login-free access to FLUX2, SDXL, and other models. It offers one-click self-hosting via Cloudflare Workers, integrates multiple AI providers like Google and OpenAI, and supports local browser storage with optional cloud sync for privacy and seamless cross-device creativity.

repos.description: 即梦海外版 | Dreamina (CapCut AI) 图像生成 API | 基于 Cloudflare Workers 部署
repos.summary_zh: 即梦海外版 Dreamina API 基于 Cloudflare Workers 构建，采用异步任务模式解决30秒超时限制。支持文生图、图生图及多模型（4.5/4.1/4.0），提供 OpenAI 兼容接口与可视化 Web 界面，全球边缘节点部署，无需服务器即可实现 AI 图像生成服务。
repos.summary_en: Dreamina API (CapCut AI) built on Cloudflare Workers uses asynchronous task mode to bypass 30s timeout limits. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, and multiple models (4.5/4.1/4.0), offers OpenAI-compatible endpoints with a visual web interface, and deploys globally via edge nodes without server infrastructure.

repos.description: 即梦jimeng/dreamina文生图和图生图的官网api，借鉴了几位大佬的项目，但他们的参数都有些小问题，稍加改进下，稳定性强了不少，目前只测试了文生图和图生图功能，应该没啥问题了，有问题欢迎提issue
repos.summary_zh: 即梦API是一个基于国内站即梦AI和国际站dreamina的逆向工程实现，提供OpenAI兼容接口的文生图/图生图/视频生成服务。支持多模型、灵活分辨率与比例设置，具备智能轮询、异常处理及Docker容器化部署能力，适用于个人研究与开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Jimeng API is a reverse-engineered service based on domestic Jimeng AI and international Dreamina, offering OpenAI-compatible interfaces for text-to-image, image-to-image, and video generation. It supports multiple models, flexible resolution/ratio settings, adaptive polling, error handling, and Docker deployment for personal research use.

repos.summary_zh: AutoRedEnvelopeScript 是一个基于 Python、OpenCV 和 pyautogui 的自动化红包抢包工具，通过图像识别技术检测弹窗并模拟点击操作。用户需先用 screenshot.py 生成模板截图并填写坐标，再在 main.py 中配置实时定位，适用于安卓投屏或模拟器场景下的红包自动化处理。
repos.summary_en: AutoRedEnvelopeScript is a Python-based automation tool using OpenCV and pyautogui to detect red envelope popups via image recognition and simulate human-like clicks. Users generate template screenshots with screenshot.py, input coordinates into main.py for real-time detection, enabling automated red packet grabbing on Android devices or emulators.

repos.description: 一键批量抠图。两种方法。一.使用remove.bg网站账号免费api额度，二.使用rembg和onnxruntime训练模型本地抠图
repos.summary_zh: Image_matting 提供一键批量抠图功能，支持两种模式：使用 remove.bg 在线 API（高精度需网络）或本地 rembg+onnxruntime 模型（快速清晰需算力）。自动轮换 API 密钥解决额度问题，支持批量处理与文件名规范，适用于电商、设计等领域。
repos.summary_en: Image_matting enables one-click batch background removal with two modes: using remove.bg's online API (higher accuracy, requires internet) or local rembg+onnxruntime model (faster, clearer, requires hardware). It auto-rotates API keys to bypass limits, supports batch processing and standardized file naming, ideal for e-commerce and design workflows.
